fact: The red top of the Southern Cross — the nearest red giant to the Sun.
bio: Gacrux (Gamma Crucis) is a cool red giant about 89 light-years away, the closest red giant to our Solar System. Its warm orange light sits at the head of the Southern Cross, a vivid contrast to the hot blue stars that form the rest of the figure.
cultural: Its name is a modern contraction of 'Gamma Crucis'. As part of Crux it features in southern-hemisphere navigation and appears, with its companions, on several national flags of the south.
